<thought>We need to determine the number of CH₃ (methyl) groups in the unknown compound. The most direct way is to examine its ¹H NMR spectrum, looking for singlets (or appropriate multiplets) around 0.8–1.2 ppm that integrate to three protons each. The tool `proton_nmr_spectra` returns the ¹H NMR spectrum for the sample at hand, requiring no additional arguments. By analyzing that spectrum we can count the methyl signals and thus answer the question.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
